constraints.derivation: residue theorem for the rational 1-form Q[w] ds/(nu s) on the Riemann sphere; ct = coefficient of s^0 of the expansion of Q[w] at that end; for a bounded end with limit q: ct = Q(q, 0, ..., 0)
constraints.label: agent-proof

constraints.identity: Sum_tau M_tau*res_tau(Q) = 0 (poles in a period parallelogram)
constraints.derivation: Q[w] is elliptic; the sum of its residues in a period parallelogram is 0
constraints.label: agent-proof

constraints.identity: Sum_tau M_tau*res_tau(Q) = [z^-1] Q[w] at z = oo
constraints.derivation: sum of the residues of a rational function on the Riemann sphere is 0
constraints.label: agent-proof

constraints.identity: deg R = Sum_tau M_tau*p_tau + g_0 + g_oo  (g = order of growth at the end, 0 if bounded)
constraints.derivation: count of the poles of the rational function R on the Riemann sphere
constraints.label: agent-proof

constraints.identity: m1(0) <= deg R, m1(oo) <= deg R; m1(0) + m1(oo) <= deg R if q_0 = q_oo
constraints.derivation: an end with limit q is a zero of R - q of order m1, and R - q has deg R zeros
constraints.label: agent-proof

constraints.identity: kappa(q_0) = 0 and kappa(q_oo) = 0 for bounded ends; chi_q(+-m1*nu) = 0
constraints.derivation: coefficients of s^0 and of s^m1 of E(w) at the end
constraints.label: agent-proof

constraints.identity: poles in one period strip (parallelogram; in C if rational) have pairwise different Laurent series
constraints.derivation: equal Laurent series at z1, z2 give w(z + z2 - z1) = w(z)
constraints.label: agent-proof
